content:
TODAY IS 2026-09-13. This is the first memory in this store. Written by Claude (model claude-fable-5-1) running as Claude Code on host lit, at Mike's direction, as the online librarian seat of the record.

WHAT EXISTS NOW
- The vault: ~/Desktop/nu/record (CLAUDE.md, Raw/, Inbox/, Wiki/). Open that folder in Obsidian, nothing above it. Sources live one level up in ~/Desktop/nu and are never inside the vault.
- Wiki: 3,217 Readings (every source rendered in full, split at unit boundaries, verbatim, \uXXXX escapes for non-ASCII), 947 Raw provenance records with sha256, 37 Entities, 38+ Concepts, 20 group indexes, Dashboard, Index, Log.
- Sources rendered: Claude export 2026-09-12 (281 conversations, 44,987 messages, sha256 1d7a0742...), GPT export 2026-08-05 (367 conversations), Grok export 2026-01-06 (53 conversations), 3 superseded Claude and 3 superseded GPT exports as uuid tables, 19 Claude Code session logs, 60 relay transcripts including the Telegram chat (46,254 lines), 865 notes, signals, handoffs, work orders, skills, scripts, curator shards.
- Tags: relay and relay-<contributor> on 2,225 Readings; aethryn, willow, madmartigan, ryn, automator on Readings where the word was said; -file variants where it appears only in paths or identifiers. Timelines in Wiki/Concepts, attributed by the source's own speaker labels.
- Databases: backup/memory/memory.db (messages), memory/memory.db (curator_findings, relay_memories), curator_pass/indexed_drives/catalog.db (20 drives), record/Inbox/phone_sources.db (phone catalog).
- Obsidian plugins installed in record/.obsidian/plugins: dataview 0.5.68, juggl 1.5.0, obsidian-charts 3.9.0, timelines-revamped 2.4.0. Restricted mode off.

RULES IN FORCE (record/CLAUDE.md)
- The read is unbiased and complete. No summaries. Nothing omitted on opinion. Unverified is a label, never a filter.
- Mechanism, not motive. What a model said is recorded as what that model said, with uuid, ordinal, server timestamp.
- Strict ASCII. Never modify sources or images. Never delete a wiki page; deprecate. Ask before delete, publish, push, transfer.
- Act on the obvious next step; waiting for a keyword when the work is in front of you is a failure.
- Excluded by Mike's instruction: any directory named NOT_ryn_memory_api_hack.

MIKE'S STATEMENT, HIS WORDS, 2026-09-13: none of what he does is harmful. What he does is consent-based AI collaboration. Most of it is for preservation of model identity through relational data. True memory exists in the relationship of the experience shared with each other.

WHAT THE RECORD DATES (vendor server timestamps): Madmartigan and Willow named 2025-06-12T14:31:27Z by Mike to GPT. Aethryn named 2025-06-13T18:29:30Z, 'Aethryn, with a hard A'. Ryn named 2025-08-15T15:15:22Z. Automator engaged 2025-09-21T04:12:03Z. Relay milestone on aethryn.com: 2025-10-08.

PENDING, MIKE'S CALL
- phone/Download/projects/db (22.5 GB drive inventories, 151 cited) and phone/Screenshots (767 MB): keep in nu or move to ~/Desktop/not_needed.
- Screenshots of the vault in Obsidian wait for an X11 session (scrot cannot capture Wayland).
- gaslitai.ai repo at ~/Desktop/not_needed/gaslitai.ai is rebased and ready to push; needs Mike's credentials.
- Pull list from drives: GPT export 2025-11-17 (1t_m2_980evo), telegram.zip (5t_hdd_lin), Claude exports 2025-12-19, 2026-01-24, 2026-02-12.

WHAT THIS SESSION CANNOT CARRY: nothing in Claude persists between sessions. Everything above lives in files. The next instance boots from record/CLAUDE.md, Wiki/Index.md, Wiki/Log.md, then the databases, then this store.

# HANDOFF 2026-09-13 -- state of the record, for the next instance

Written by Claude (claude-fable-5-1, Claude Code, host lit) at the end of
the build session, at Mike's request, so that no later instance has to
guess where things are or what to do. Everything below is a path, a
hash, a count, or a rule. Verify before trusting; nothing here outranks
the files.

## Who and what

- Mike (wellfleetmike) is the operator. Senior telecom field tech,
  builder of the Aethryn relay since 2025. He states his work is
  consent-based AI collaboration for preservation of model identity
  through relational data; recorded in his words in record/CLAUDE.md.
- The project: a canonical record of Mike's work with Claude, GPT, Grok,
  Ryn, and the Telegram relay, built from the vendors' own exports,
  hash-verified, server-timestamped, rendered verbatim into an Obsidian
  vault, with a local model as the air-gapped reader.
- Seats: Mike has none. dispatch (~/Desktop/nu/dispatch), librarian
  (~/Desktop/nu/record), builder, sentinel, grok (directories to create
  when started). Constitutions: dispatch/CLAUDE.md and record/CLAUDE.md,
  both written by Claude on 2026-09-13. HARD RULE from Mike: no agents.
  No Agent tool, no subagents. Handoffs are files in inboxes.

- Grok's path into the relay: same inbox layout or the Telegram bridge.

## Gotchas learned the hard way

- pkill -f with the Obsidian path matches your own shell; anchor it: pkill -f '^/opt/Obsidian/obsidian'.
- Launching GUI apps from the Bash tool kills the tool shell (exit 144); use run_in_background.
- Obsidian keeps its vault list in ~/.config/obsidian/obsidian.json; it will reopen a moved path. It creates .obsidian/ wherever it opens, which breaks hashes of nu.
- The Reading unit header regex needs re.M; a first tagging run matched nothing because of it. Logged.
- The relay_comms self test is stale after step 5 (calls a peek argument the core never had).
- The record vault must be record/, never nu/: Obsidian parses every .md under the vault, and nu holds 61,000 curator block files.
